name: prompt-grammar
description: Antigravity plugin that checks the grammar of each prompt you send, shows fixes inline, tracks mistake history, and provides /grammar stats, review, and ask.

scripts.build: bun build scripts/hook.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/hook.mjs && bun build scripts/cli.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.mjs && bun build scripts/check-worker.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/check-worker.mjs && bun build scripts/statusline.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/statusline.mjs
